name: Band pull-apart
cues: Hold the band at shoulder height with straight arms
Pull your hands apart until the band touches your chest
Squeeze your shoulder blades together
Keep your ribs down and your arms level

name: Band face pull
cues: Anchor the band at face height
Pull the ends toward your ears with elbows high
Squeeze your shoulder blades together
Keep your wrists straight and your ribs down

name: Band lateral raise
cues: Stand on the band with a handle in each hand
Lead with your elbows
Raise to shoulder height
Stay tall and keep steady tension on the band

name: Band overhead press
cues: Stand on the band and hold the handles at your shoulders
Brace your trunk
Press overhead until your arms are straight
Keep your ribs down and do not arch your back

name: Band seated row
cues: Sit with your legs out and the band around your feet
Keep your back tall
Pull your elbows back past your torso
Return slowly

name: Band lat pulldown
cues: Anchor the band high and kneel or sit under it
Pull your elbows down toward your ribs
Keep your chest up
Return slowly

name: Band-assisted pull-up
cues: Loop the band over the bar and place a foot or knee in it
Start with straight arms
Pull until your chin clears the bar
Check the band is secured to the bar and use a stable step to get in and out

name: Band chest press
cues: Anchor the band behind you at chest height
Stand in a split stance and brace
Press forward until your arms are straight
Check the anchor is firm before you press

name: Band chest fly
cues: Anchor the band behind you at chest height
Keep a soft bend in your elbows
Bring your hands together in front of your chest
Open slowly with control

name: Band biceps curl
cues: Stand on the band with your elbows at your sides
Curl up without swinging
Squeeze at the top
Keep the band flat under your feet

name: Band triceps pushdown
cues: Anchor the band overhead
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides
Press down until your arms are straight
Check the anchor is firm and keep your wrists straight

name: Banded squat
cues: Stand on the band with the other end over your shoulders
Brace and sit down between your hips
Keep your heels down
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes

name: Band good morning
cues: Stand on the band with the other end across your upper back
Push your hips back with a flat back
Stop at a strong hamstring stretch
Drive your hips forward to stand

name: Band pull-through
cues: Anchor the band low behind you and step forward
Hinge your hips back with a flat back
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes
Keep your arms relaxed

name: Band lateral walk
cues: Place the band above your knees or around your ankles
Stay in a quarter squat
Step sideways without letting your knees cave in
Keep tension on the band the whole time

name: Band external rotation
cues: Anchor the band at elbow height
Keep your elbow at your side bent to 90 degrees
Rotate your forearm outward
Keep your wrist in line with your forearm

name: Band Pallof press
cues: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on
Hold your hands at your chest and brace
Press straight out without twisting
Hold briefly and return
